axis_mapping: IMU +X = base -X; IMU +Y = base -Y; IMU +Z = base +Z.
axis_basis: Final explicit user definition; not inferred from the historical CAD envelope rotation.
measurement_point_basis: Front point on lateral centerline and thickness midplane: housing center +14 mm along base +X, 6 mm behind the front (+X) edge. Supersedes the earlier rear-origin inference.
virtual_policy_frame: policy_aligned_imu remains at base origin, identity axes.
